STAGE_KEYED._doc: STAGE_KEYED (Phase 070c): the tables keyed by life stage whose per-stage entries may be inherited. Each path names a table (and a key inside it; '*' takes every row of the level above, as DISEASE.*.stage_risk). At pack load (domains/pack.py _compile_life_stages) a stage with no entry in such a dict takes the entry of its nearest ancestor in LIFE_STAGES[stage].inherits. The LIFE_STAGES fields are filled the same way, except age_min and age_max, which each stage gives. LIFE_STAGE_CHAIN (derived) is each stage with its ancestors, nearest first: a comparison by name asks whether a stage has the name in its chain (the infant refusal, dependant membership). The preschooler (3 to 5 years, NSF preschool range, Hirshkowitz et al. 2015) inherits every value from child and overlays only BODY_RATES.sleep_need_hours (10 h, the low end of 10 to 13 h). The band edges are integer years and must be contiguous (the self-test checks it); infant 0 to 2, preschooler 3 to 5, child 6 to 12 (the whole-year rule of DEPENDANTS-off, which sends a gap age to elder, is unchanged).
